editionLabel: HUCH! 2020 multilingual rules, English two-player section
firstPlayerRule: Whoever most recently walked in a forest while wondering whether hidden folk exist goes first.
houseFallback: If this criterion does not suit your group, agree to choose randomly. This is a house rule.
clarifications: The first player places a card from their hand and draws a replacement at the end of the turn.
